build_conditioning_attributes: build a ConditioningAttributes dataclass to hold text, wav, joint_embed, and symbolic conditioning data for audio generation
create_t5_conditioner: create a T5Conditioner to embed text descriptions using a pretrained T5 model for music generation conditioning
create_chroma_stem_conditioner: create a ChromaStemConditioner to extract chroma features from audio stems using DEMUCS source separation
create_clap_embedding_conditioner: create a CLAPEmbeddingConditioner to compute joint audio-text embeddings using a pretrained CLAP model for conditioning
build_conditioning_provider: build a ConditioningProvider to tokenize and process multiple conditioners and return embedding-mask pairs for music generation
